# Licences of the conformance-suite inputs

Everything under `tests/fixtures/conformance/` is fictitious. It is either written for
this project (MIT, like ged_io), vendored from a source whose licence allows it, or
derived as facts from licensed specification data. Material whose terms do not allow
vendoring is never copied: `tools/fetch-corpora.sh` fetches it at test time, pinned by
commit and SHA-256 in `tests/fixtures/corpora.lock.tsv`.

| `src/spec/tables.rs` (7.0, 7.1), read by the suite through `tests/conformance/support/spec_tables.rs` | FamilySearch/GEDCOM `extracted-files/` at `512e38d` (main) and `c451779` (v7.1) | Apache-2.0; attribution in the repository `NOTICE` |
| `src/spec/tables.rs` (5.5.1) | cacack/gedcom-go `testdata/spec/gedcom-5.5.1/` at `3c6d42d`, completed by `tools/spec-tables/551-errata.tsv` (page references to `docs/ged551.pdf`) | MIT, Copyright (c) 2025 Chris Clonch |

GEDCOM-registries has no licence: it is only fetched (`tools/fetch-corpora.sh
--registries`) for the opt-in cross-check, and nothing from it is copied.

## Project-authored (MIT)

`cases/*.txt`, `maximal551.ged` (completion records generated by the probe generator),
`extensions70.ged`, `full551.ged` and `full70.ged` (the hand-written "every structure"
files of the 5.5.1 and 7.0 conformance reviews), `known_gaps.tsv` and
`corpora_baseline*.tsv`. The cases reimplement the
intents of other suites (python-gedcom7, ArmidaleSoftware/gedcom7, gedcom4j, Gramps,
gedcom-go) with invented content; no line of a GPL, non-commercial or unlicensed file is
reused.
